messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout started for service=router-api v3 -> v4 in eu-west-1. change-window 2024-06-18 11:15-12:00 UTC. traffic plan: 0→25% (10m probe), 25→75% (20m ramp), final 100% (10m). rollback-trigger: 5xx > 3% OR p95 latency +200ms. runbook: /playbooks/router-weighted-shift.md
Maya: I'm on lead for the cutover, oncall @Sanjay. tagging @Alex for LB pinning.
Alex: ack — will pre-stage LB rules, can pin session-affinity cohorts if needed. prepping health-check override.
Sanjay: oncall here, monitoring dashboards + traces. I'll watch p95 and 5xx -> will call rollback if thresholds crossed.
deploy-bot: 11:25 UTC — weight at 25%. canary probes: healthy=98/100, 5xx=0.8%, p95 +15ms. continuing.
Maya: holding on slight tail latency in region-b; @Alex can you confirm backend queue depth?
Alex: seeing worker queue @3.2x baseline for router-workers-3; increasing steady-state CPU. pushing a scaledown override for warm pods.
deploy-bot: 11:35 UTC — ramp to 50% paused for manual hold per @Maya.
Sanjay: alert: 5xx increased to 2.6% over 3m, request rate stable. digging traces to router-api v4. suspect header parsing change.
Maya: decision point — hold + pin at 25% and run smoke tests. no full rollback yet. @Alex apply temporary route pin for premium cohort.
Alex: applied pin for cohort=premium -> v3 (old) via LB rule id lb-chi-342. verifying.
Rachel: QA ran smoke set, failing case in auth handshake (token TTL) — repro on v4 only.
Maya: ok we can't risk further. Decision: rollback to v3 for all traffic. rollback approved by @Maya, @Sanjay, @Alex. initiating.
Alex: executing rollback: kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/router-api; also reverting LB rules to point to v3.
deploy-bot: 11:48 UTC — rollback started. draining v4 instances: graceful drain 120s, decreasing weight 25→0 over 3m.
Maya: monitoring now. postmortem note: will pin v3 and schedule follow-up patch for header handling. release notes update: "router-api v4 rollback due to auth handshake regression".
Sanjay: rollback complete at 11:53 UTC. 5xx back to baseline 0.2%, p95 within expected.
Maya: thanks team. Action items: (1) @Alex reproduce locally + fix token parsing, (2) @Rachel create regression test, (3) schedule next rollout in change window with shorter cohorts. adding to release/notes and ticket INF-2143.
Alex: copying notes to infra-runbook and will open PR for patch.
deploy-bot: 11:56 UTC — thread closed. :white_check_mark:
